name: game-production-pipeline
description: Co-design game inception with the owner, approve bounded production authority, then run auditable multi-agent execution, repair, review, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Build auditable multi-agent teams for game production.
interface.longDescription: Develop a game idea with the owner across design, art, UI, technology, scope and acceptance. Confirm a launch charter and project-specific team, then execute bounded production with independent review, recovery, evidence and exception-only escalation.
defaultPrompt: Initialize this game project with an auditable multi-agent production pipeline.
Develop my game idea with me and prepare a launch packet for low-intervention production.
Show the current game production organization and pending staffing decisions.
Continue production under the approved charter until delivery or an exception requires my decision.
Research and establish a production-ready art direction that also translates coherently into UI visuals.
